Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Chuck Hayes?

Chuck Hayes is 43 years old.

Where was Chuck Hayes born?

Chuck Hayes was born in San Leandro, California.

When was Chuck Hayes born?

Chuck Hayes was born on June 11, 1983.

How tall is Chuck Hayes?

Chuck Hayes is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much did Chuck Hayes weigh when playing?

Chuck Hayes weighed 240 lbs (108 kg) when playing.

Is Chuck Hayes in the Hall of Fame?

Chuck Hayes is not in the Hall of Fame.

What position did Chuck Hayes play?

Center and Power Forward.

When did Chuck Hayes retire?

Chuck Hayes last played in 2016.

What is Chuck Hayes' net worth?

Chuck Hayes made at least $30,767,542 playing professional basketball.

How much did Chuck Hayes make?

Chuck Hayes made $5,958,750 in 2015.

What did Chuck Hayes average?

Chuck Hayes averaged 3.7 points, 5.0 rebounds, and 1.2 assists per game.

How many rings does Chuck Hayes have?

Chuck Hayes won 0 championships.

What schools did Chuck Hayes attend?

Chuck Hayes attended Modesto Christian in Modesto, California and Kentucky.

What are Chuck Hayes' nicknames?

Chuck Wagon is a nickname for Chuck Hayes.
